activity.notes: User-supplied COMMODVS is normalized to Commodus. Oxford gives his sole imperial reign as 180–192 CE and separately notes that he was Augustus and co-ruler from 177; ATLAS uses the principal sole-emperor interval.

sources.title: Commodus, Roman emperor - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Commodus as sole Roman emperor from 180 to 192 CE and notes his earlier co-rule from 177.
